title: Trading bot help
author: G00ber13
selftext: Has anyone here built a successful AI powered stock trading bot? (by successful I mean profitable at the end of the week)  I’ve created one using ChatGPT and had it create a shadow trading system to test different strategies against the real market and when those look promising it paper trades them with Alpaca… my problem is I can’t seem to create a repeatable and profitable strategy with rules. It seems like each week I either damn near break even or take small losses.  I’m looking for insight or recommendations to improve my system.
